sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 19.42 (+12.91%) indica un mercato difensivo, mentre l'S&P 500 è sceso del -1.82% nella seduta di venerdì. Il DXY a 101.87 (-0.01%) è leggermente debole, ma il forte ribasso del Brent a $110.06 (-6.44%) e la contrazione del TLT (+0.43%) segnalano pressione inflazionistica e rialzo dei tassi, confermando un sentiment risk‑off. Gold a $3,917 (+0.47%) e il BTC a $78,086 (+0.33%) mostrano un rifugio limitato, ma non sufficiente a invertire la tendenza negativa.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 19.42 (+12.91%) points to a defensive market, while the S&P 500 fell -1.82% in Friday's session. The DXY at 101.87 (-0.01%) is marginally weak, yet the sharp Brent drop to $110.06 (-6.44%) and the modest rise in TLT (+0.43%) signal inflationary pressure and higher rates, confirming a risk‑off sentiment. Gold at $3,917 (+0.47%) and BTC at $78,086 (+0.33%) provide limited safe‑haven support but do not reverse the downside.

market_impact_summary.it: Equity: S&P 500 -1.82% e STOXX 600 -0.39% indicano un ritiro diffuso; l'Euro STOXX 50 futures preannunciano un avvio negativo. Fixed Income: TLT +0.43% e US 10Y Yield a 4.92% (-1.20%) mostrano compressione dei rendimenti, segnale di tassi in rialzo. Commodities: Brent -6.44% (bearish) mentre Gold +0.47% (mixed). Le viste di BlackRock (outlook di liquidità globale in contrazione) e Goldman Sachs (rischio di recessione da AI‑driven credit tightening) rafforzano il quadro risk‑off.
market_impact_summary.en: Equities: S&P 500 -1.82% and STOXX 600 -0.39% reflect a broad pullback; Euro STOXX 50 futures signal a negative start. Fixed Income: TLT +0.43% and US 10Y Yield at 4.92% (-1.20%) indicate yield compression, a sign of rising rates. Commodities: Brent -6.44% (bearish) while Gold +0.47% (mixed). BlackRock's outlook on tightening global liquidity and Goldman Sachs' warning on AI‑driven credit tightening both reinforce the risk‑off environment.
